subject: Service place-of-supply evidence and UK tax flow for Skydock
messages:
From: David Shaw <david.shaw@skydock.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@skydock.io
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:12:00 +0000
Subject: Question on UK VAT treatment for services supplied by Redwood

Hi Tessa / Laura,

We're finalizing procurement for the telemetry integration (Skydock <> Redwood) and need to confirm how Redwood will be invoicing us for ongoing monthly usage. Skydock is a UK legal entity and expects to handle VAT via reverse charge for B2B services, but our tax team asked for three things before we accept:

- A short explanation of how Redwood determines place-of-supply for hosted inference services (are these considered supplied where the customer is located?).
- Confirmation whether Redwood will treat the invoices as reverse-charge (i.e., net value on the invoice) or issue VAT-charged invoices.
- Any supporting evidence Redwood will accept as proof of our VAT registration (VIES screenshot, VAT certificate).

I've attached our internal tax profile (skydock_tax_profile.xlsx) which includes our UK VAT number and billing address. Please let me know if you need anything else to proceed. Procurement would like this cleared before the PO is issued.

Thanks,
David
David Shaw
Head of Procurement, Skydock Logistics
procurement@skydock.io

Attachment: skydock_tax_profile.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Question on UK VAT treatment for services supplied by Redwood

Hi David — thanks for the details and the attachment. Quick summary and proposed next steps below.

Short answer (where we typically land):
- For hosted inference (SaaS-style) and professional services tied to that service, Redwood treats place-of-supply as the customer's business location for B2B sales. For a UK-registered business that's VAT-registered, the UK reverse-charge normally applies.

What we need from Skydock to apply reverse-charge on our invoices:
- Valid UK VAT number (you've provided one in the spreadsheet) and a VIES validation screenshot or VAT certificate for audit evidence.
- Billing contact and billing address to appear on the invoice exactly as on your certificate.

What Redwood will issue if evidence is provided:
- Invoice with net amounts and a note: "Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the customer under Article 194 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC" (we'll include the customer's VAT number).
- If the customer prefers self-billing, we can support a self-billing arrangement; procurement should confirm acceptance and provide a PO reference.

Attachments and examples: I've attached our short RC FAQ (RC-FAQ.pdf) and a proposed invoice template for your review (invoice_proposal-template.pdf).

Proposed quick actions:
1) David: confirm that Skydock accepts reverse-charge invoicing and attach the VIES screenshot or VAT certificate.
2) Procurement: confirm PO reference and whether you want self-billing.
3) Ben / Laura: if RC is accepted, Ben will prepare the first net invoice and we will include the RC wording.

Happy to hop on a short call if that helps.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Lead — EMEA
Redwood Inference
T: +44 20 5555 1234
E: tessa_morgan@redwood.com

David — copying pricing and ops details here.

If Skydock confirms reverse-charge, we'll issue monthly net invoices and include your VAT ID on each invoice. A couple of operational notes so procurement is aware:
- We need the exact billing address and VAT ID as printed on your certificate (no PO box).
- For the contract/MAA: our commercial team typically adds the RC clause to the invoice workflow; we do not change product pricing when RC applies.
- If Skydock wants self-billing, we can enable it but need a signed self-billing agreement (we'll share a DocuSign link once procurement confirms).

Action for procurement: confirm whether you want self-billing or standard vendor-invoicing; if self-billing, we'll send the DocuSign.

Thanks — I can draft the first net invoice as soon as we have the VIES evidence.
